title: Lausa Standworth
kicker: a broad-shouldered elder carrying a barrel like it weighs nothing
hook: a broad-shouldered elder carrying a barrel like it weighs nothing

blocks.label: Public Read
blocks.body: A broad alewife leans over a wooden mug, braid tucked back, forearm tattoo visible, with enough warmth in her smile to make a room confess.

blocks.label: Comes Across As
blocks.body: Warm enough to make a room confess, shrewd enough to know exactly why it should not. Calls her love irritation because love sounds too soft out loud. Marks who enters town twice and remembers every unpaid kindness.
